question: During a high-stakes client meeting, two of your coworkers suddenly engage in a heated argument. The client becomes visibly uncomfortable and stressed by the unprofessional display. What is the most effective and professional action for you to take to manage the situation?

options: Choose to let the heated argument play out completely before deciding to offer an explanation or apology to the client after the meeting has concluded.
Decisively redirect the conversation toward the primary meeting objectives and suggest that your coworkers continue their discussion at a later time in a private setting.
Immediately intervene to end the client meeting abruptly and firmly ask every person present in the room to leave the premises to stop the conflict.
Intervene by taking the client out of the room entirely while your coworkers continue to argue amongst themselves until they decide to stop on their own.
options_hi: तीखी बहस को पूरी तरह समाप्त होने दें, फिर बैठक समाप्त होने के बाद क्लाइंट को स्पष्टीकरण देने या उससे क्षमा माँगने का निर्णय लें।

तुरंत हस्तक्षेप करके क्लाइंट बैठक को अचानक समाप्त कर दें और संघर्ष रोकने के लिए कमरे में उपस्थित प्रत्येक व्यक्ति को परिसर छोड़ने के लिए दृढ़ता से कहें।
क्लाइंट को कमरे से पूरी तरह बाहर ले जाकर हस्तक्षेप करें, जबकि आपके सहकर्मी तब तक आपस में बहस करते रहें जब तक वे स्वयं रुकने का निर्णय न लें।
explanation: Correct answer: Option B — Decisively redirect the conversation toward the primary meeting objectives and suggest that your coworkers continue their discussion at a later time in a private setting.

options_hi: बिना कोई स्पष्टीकरण दिए उनकी कॉल को पूरी तरह अनदेखा करें।

क्लाइंट को संतुष्ट रखने के लिए कॉल लेते रहें, भले ही इससे आपको तनाव हो।

explanation: Correct answer: Option B — Politely note you value the relationship but must keep calls professional to ensure good service.
explanation_hi: Correct answer: Option B — Politely note you value the relationship but must keep calls professional to ensure good service.

question:

II. इस पहल का उद्देश्य स्वास्थ्य सेवा की सुलभता में सुधार करना है।
options: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
निष्कर्ष I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं
explanation: Correct answer: Option D — Both conclusions I and II follow

question: The plant manager has introduced a mandatory virtual reality (VR) safety training program for all employees handling high-voltage machinery to reduce workplace accidents. Which assumption underlies this program?

explanation_hi: Correct answer: Option A — VR training provides a level of practical exposure that effectively improves real-world employee safety.
